lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that Aaron must set up the seven lamps, and the lampstand is made of hammered gold.
The LORD tells Moses to cleanse the Levites with purification water and have them take a young bull.
The LORD tells Moses to bring the Levites to the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron to present them.
The LORD took the Levites in place of the firstborn He set apart when He sent the locusts.
Levite men thirty years or older enter the work at the Tent of Meeting, and at fifty they retire.
